commits_at_first_review.message:
feat(search): add fuzzy subsequence matching for find/replace

Implement roadmap #17 with a backtracking fzf-like matcher, CM search panel toggle, and electron-demo search bar integration.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

fix(search): address fuzzy search panel and navigation edge cases

Wire fuzzy replace in CM panel, suppress literal CM highlights when fuzzy is active, sync fuzzy state on external setQuery, fix next/previous navigation, and add pattern/token length guards.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

fix(search): polish fuzzy search performance and panel parity

Skip redundant fuzzy state dispatches, disable selection highlight while fuzzy is active, use incremental replace-all changes, advance after replace-next, unify demo navigation helpers, and defer external query sync.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

fix(search): restore highlights in live preview and demo search bar

Wire search highlights through core live-preview (tables, inline code, wiki links) and fix the electron-demo search bar so typing no longer steals focus while matches stay visible.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
